analysis.title: US Watch: October PCE inflation tracking: Tracking 0.29% m/m for core PCE after PPI
key_insights: BofA now tracks October core PCE at 0.29% m/m (3.2% y/y), down from 0.32% (3.3%), after PPI components that feed into PCE came in weaker on balance than assumed. The PPI lowered the tracking estimate by 3bp.
BofA tracks October headline PCE at 0.30% m/m (3.8% y/y), down from 0.34% (3.9%).
BofA says inflation remains too high and momentum has picked up in recent months. It expects the Fed to raise rates by 25bp at each of its next three meetings, taking the terminal rate to 4.5%-4.75%.
